name: Axiomancer
description:
A scholar who found out that a sufficiently rigorous thought has mass. They observe a target until nothing about it is unknown, work out what must happen next, and reality has no choice but to follow the proof.

First Principles turns your Smarts, and a little of your Psi Power, into a small shield pool that needs no shield in hand and keeps refilling even while you are surrounded, so a hybrid build can wade into a swarm. Cold Read files a Case Study on an enemy and may Silence, Expose or Weaken it. Notes are your offense: Refutation turns a studied enemy's attacks back on it, Excluded Middle and Grand Synthesis cash them in. Insight is your defense: it swells the pool, and Cognitive Shell and Grand Synthesis spend it. Favors [SMT] and [PSI].

effects.name: Insight
effects.description: What you have worked out so far. Each stack adds 1 to your shield pool. You can hold 8, and one more for every 5 Smarts above 16, up to 12. It fades if you stop working.

effects.name: Case Study
effects.description: It has been observed closely. Every note is one more weakness on record, and each one leaves it more open to Psi.

effects.name: Sealed Reasoning
effects.description: Nothing gets through a closed proof: you shrug off much of the Piercing and Psi damage that goes around or through a shield.

effects.name: Under Pressure
effects.description: Enemies on every side only sharpen the reasoning: their blows no longer interrupt your shield pool's refill.

effects.name: Separated
effects.description: Set apart by definition. It cannot move.

effects.name: Lucidity
effects.description: For a few moments, knowing a thing and doing it are the same act. Every stack adds 3 to your shield pool, and every skill you use adds to your Insight.

newAbility.name: First Principles
newAbility.description: A sufficiently rigorous thought has mass. You keep a small shield pool made of nothing but reasoning, no shield in hand needed: 1 point for every 3 Smarts and every 6 Psi Power. It refills on its own the way health does: 1 point every 8 turns with no gear needed, 1 turn sooner for every 12 Smarts and Psi Power combined, or your gear's rate if that is better. Hits restart the count, but with two or more enemies beside you, you are Under Pressure and their blows no longer interrupt it.

newAbility.name: Cold Read
newAbility.description: Study it closely. Its habits, its weak points and its timing all go into the Case Study, and with 12 Smarts you take twice the notes. What you learn can be used at once: it may be Silenced, Exposed or Weakened, with better odds the higher your Smarts. Every look gives you Insight.

perk.name: Second Glance
perk.description: The second pass always turns up what the first one missed.

newAbility.name: Refutation
newAbility.description: An attack you predicted is only evidence. When your shield takes a hit from an enemy with a Case Study, one note is spent to disprove it: the blow turns back on the attacker as Psi damage, your shield recharges 1 and you gain Insight. Up to 3 times a turn.

newAbility.name: Quiet Mind
newAbility.description: A mind left idle cools into clarity. Waiting a turn gives Insight (more with 16 Smarts) and recovers stamina and a little shield pool in proportion to your Smarts. Ending a turn in a fight with your stamina nearly full turns the unspent effort into Insight.

newAbility.name: Cognitive Shell
newAbility.description: Close the proof around yourself and spend what it taught you.
newAbility.rules:
• Spends all your Insight: overshield of 4 (+0.3 per Smarts and Psi Power, +2 per Insight), and your shield pool recharges 2 (+1 per Insight).
• Sealed Reasoning for 3 turns: +25% Piercing and +15% Psi resistance, the damage a shield lets through.
• Your other cooldowns -1.

perk.name: Airtight
perk.description: While the proof is sealed, every blow against it goes on record against whoever struck.

newAbility.name: Excluded Middle
newAbility.description: Everything is either known or not known, and there is no third option. Each enemy around you with a Case Study takes Psi damage, more for every note on it, and the notes stay. Each enemy without one gets a Case Study of 2 notes.

perk.name: Sound Logic
perk.description: Whatever is thoroughly on record has no unrecorded moves left.

newAbility.name: Axiom of Separation
newAbility.description: Any collection can be divided by a rule, and you are the rule. Everything within 2 tiles is thrown 2 tiles away from you, enemies with a Case Study are held in place for 2 turns where they land, and your shield recharges 2.

perk.name: Clean Partition
perk.description: The rule admits no exceptions: all of it is set apart, studied or not.

newAbility.name: Lucid Apotheosis
newAbility.description: Stop thinking about the power and simply understand it. You gain one stack of Lucidity, plus one more for each of 8, 12, 16, 20 and 24 Smarts you have: +3 shield pool per stack for 4 turns, recharged as it arrives. While it lasts, every skill you use adds Insight.

perk.name: Applied Clarity
perk.description: While you are Lucid, striking a thing and studying it are the same act.

newAbility.name: Grand Synthesis
newAbility.description: Combine everything you have established into one finished proof, and reality has to accept the result. Each enemy around you takes Psi damage that grows with your Smarts and Psi Power and with every note on it, and all its notes are spent. An enemy with 3 or more notes is Silenced for 2 turns. All your Insight is spent too: your shield recharges 2, plus 2 for each one. If you are Lucid, every enemy caught is stunned for a turn.

perk.name: Corollaries
perk.description: A finished proof implies the next one. Whatever survives it is already on record.
